items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low to the west of the British Isles, with associated weather fronts moving eastwards.


##Wind##

Mostly south or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the west of the area at first.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, becoming mainly fair later in the night and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
